{{Quote|Vader project required total razing of city of Chinshassa on planet Shalyvane to establish a credible background for subject.|Imperial data recording about [[Lumiya|Shira Brie]]|<ref name="SW62" />}}
The '''Cleansing of Shalyvane''' occurred during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==The bombing==
{{Quote|City was being lived in by my own people! Yes! Was great majesty, and wonderful comfort. But then, one day city die! Bombs fall from ships flown by people called 'Empire', yes? No reason then – no reason now. But bombs turn city to ruins, and turn my people to homeless nomads.|[[G'hinji Dros]]|<ref name="SW62" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="Gamer" /> Imperial forces attacked the planet [[Shalyvane]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Em'liy/Legends|Em'liy]], for no apparent reason. [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|bombers]] targeted and destroyed the capital [[Chinshassa]].<ref name="SW62" /> The bombing was in fact part of plot elaborated by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to infiltrate his [[Imperial Special Forces/Legends|agent]] [[Lumiya|Shira Brie]] into the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="SW63" /> Unable to rebuild their city, the disgraced Em'liy people became simply the "Nomads".<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|232|Em'liy}}</ref>

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I found that the nomads had told the Empire that my tribe was in league with the Rebel Alliance. My drunken friend said ''that'' was why they had killed them all: men&hellip;women&hellip;children. And so I joined the rebellion.|[[Lumiya|Shira Brie]]|<ref name="SW60" />}}
When she infiltrated the Rebel Alliance, Shira Brie claimed she was a native of Shalyvane, and that its [[Human/Legends|Human]] population had been wiped out by the "barbarian" Em'liy and their Imperial allies.<ref name="SW60" /> The truth was [[Skirmish at Krake Data Vault|discovered]] by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] some time after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], after the presumed death of Shira Brie during [[Battle of the secret armada]].<ref name="SW63" />
